in_hebrew.name: Emrich
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Emrich הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old German elements 'ermen' meaning 'ruler, lord' and 'ric' meaning 'power, rule'. The name Emrich has been borne by numerous individuals throughout history, particularly in Germany. It conveys a sense of strength and leadership.
